title: memware kernel service v1
description: Wire contract of the stateless memware kernel service (src/kernel/). Source of truth for the ZBuddy backend integration: handoff 'ZBuddy 后端-跨端内容与记忆同步需求 2026-09-12' §8 (N7) for the endpoints and §5 for the memory model. The service only computes: it extracts memories about the user from conversations, embeds texts, and ranks caller-supplied candidate vectors. It stores nothing. Every endpoint requires 'Authorization: Bearer <MEMWARE_KERNEL_TOKEN>' except GET /health, which container and k8s probes call without a credential; every response carries 'x-request-id'.

health.description: GET /health response. The only unauthenticated endpoint (liveness/readiness probes). Reports the deployed service version and the extraction contract version; it never exposes credentials or memory data.

version.description: Semantic version of the service package (package.json version).

extractorVersion.description: Identifies prompt + schema + gating of POST /extract. Stored with every fact; a change means the backend may re-extract. Current value: 'kernel-extract-v1'.

embeddingDim.description: Declared dimension (MEMWARE_EMBEDDING_DIM); null when unset, in which case /embed reports the dimension of the vectors it produced.

knownEntity.description: An entity the backend already stores. Its canonicalName and aliases are given to the model so repeated mentions resolve to one node.

entityType.description: Open set; first version uses person / project / topic / tool / place.

extractRequest.description: POST /extract request. userId is used for tenant isolation and is never sent to the model.

suppressedFingerprints.description: Fingerprints of memories the user deleted. Facts matching one are dropped so deletions never resurrect (handoff §5.1).

fact.description: One memory about the user themselves. Facts whose subject is another person are never emitted; those people appear as entity candidates only (handoff §5.2.1).

fingerprint.description: sha256 of the normalised content. The backend's dedup and suppression key.

type.description: Open set; 'unknown' when the model did not name one.

factIndex.description: Index into this response's own facts array.

texts.description: Empty array returns no vectors. More than MEMWARE_KERNEL_MAX_TEXTS items is rejected with payload_too_large.

vectors.description: Same order and length as the request's texts.

createdAt.description: Milliseconds epoch; drives the recency term.

docType.description: Drives the type weight; unknown types share one weight.

searchRequest.description: POST /search request. The query is either a ready vector or text the kernel embeds with the configured embedding model. Ranking is O(candidates × dim), so the candidate set is capped by MEMWARE_KERNEL_MAX_CANDIDATES (default 2000); a larger set is rejected with payload_too_large before the query is embedded.

results.description: Sorted by score descending, cut at topK and at minSimilarity.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity with the query vector.

error.description: Every non-2xx response. HTTP status follows the code: unauthorized 401, not_found 404, method_not_allowed 405, invalid_request 400, extract_output_invalid 422, dimension_mismatch 422, payload_too_large 413, upstream_failed 502, upstream_timeout 504.
